body: Create an animation-ready modular 2D cel shaded fantasy game cutout atlas, Arcane Vanguard style, bold clean dark outlines, painterly cel shading, detailed but readable at small size. Landscape high-resolution image on TRUE transparent alpha. SIX separate equally sized panels arranged THREE columns TWO rows. View directions reading order: E right profile, SE front-right threequarter, SW front-left threequarter, W left profile, NW rear-left threequarter, NE rear-right threequarter. Rear views show BACK of head/hair, BACK of clothing, no face or front chest ornament. Every panel contains exactly12 ISOLATED BODY PIECES in3columns4rows, consistent local ordering: row1 head, upper torso from neck to waist ONLY, rear cape; row2 pelvis/skirt, anatomical left upperarm, right upperarm; row3 left forearm including hand, right forearm including hand, left leg without foot; row4 right leg without foot, left boot, right boot. No full figures. Head entirely detached from torso. Arms split at elbows. Legs stop at ankles. NO equipment or effects in body sheet. Large transparent gutters between every cutout and everypanel. Avoid labels, checkerboard, background, panels, borders. Do not connect pieces. Full consistent identity across six genuine rotations. Subject: Cinder Warden male human fire sentinel, angular soot-dark face under black iron enclosed brow helmet, glowing amber eye slits, layered charcoal heatproof coat with burnt orange tabard and copper trim, thick padded gloves, heavy dark boots. Broad practical fireproof armor with ember seams, no skull no crown. Style reference is only crisp2Dcel illustration with clearblackoutlines, not a clone of any existing character. Exactly72 disconnected pieces, nofusedheadtorso, noarmsattachedtorso. Keep the rear heads genuinely backfacing.
